event_summary: A tan stick on a black circular device moves into the rightmost upright block, after which the three right-side blocks fall while the four left-side blocks remain standing.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with seven upright narrow rectangular blocks arranged in two separated groups: four blocks on the left and three blocks on the right. A black circular low cylinder is positioned behind and to the right of the right-side group, with a green piece and a tan stick attached on top. Over time the tan stick changes angle and its tip moves toward the rightmost black block in the right-side group. The stick reaches the area of that block, the rightmost black block tilts left, the adjacent white block also tilts and falls, and the remaining black block in that right-side group falls. By the end, the three right-side blocks are down on the tabletop, while the four left-side blocks are still upright.

reasons: upright blocks are visible across the tabletop
black circular device and attached stick are visible on the right
no block has fallen in the first frame
